It is located in the village of Kahala in Kuusalu Parish, Harju County.


== Physical description ==
The lake has an area of 344.9 hectares (852 acres). The lake has an average depth of 1.0 meter (3 ft 3 in) and a maximum depth of 2.8 meters (9 ft 2 in). It is 2,400 meters (7,900 ft) long, and its shoreline measures 7,370 meters (24,180 ft). It has a volume of 3,421,000 cubic meters (120,800,000 cu ft).
